title: Milk preservation methods
competency: Explain why and how milk is preserved.

keywords.def: Keeping milk safe so it does not spoil from bacteria.
Equipment used to cool milk and food.
When germs or dirt get into food or milk.

en.text: Milk preservation keeps milk safe from bacteria. Spoiled milk can cause disease, some deadly. Cooling is the main method: cold underground water was used before electricity, and today refrigerators cool milk.

screens.title: Warm milk
screens.ask: Fresh milk is left in a warm room all day. What happens?
screens.after: Warmth helps bacteria grow. Milk must be kept cool.

screens.title: 3.2.4 Milk preservation methods
paras: Milk preservation keeps milk safe so it does not spoil from bacteria.
Unsafe milk causes diseases, some of which may be deadly.
Preservation keeps milk fresh for longer.
Cooling has been the main way to keep milk fresh.

screens.title: Ways to cool milk
paras: Before electricity, cold underground water was pumped into a cooling container.
Today a refrigerator cools milk so bacteria do not grow.

defs: Keeping milk safe so it does not spoil from bacteria.

screens.text: What is the main method of keeping milk fresh?

screens.text: Milk that is not kept safely can cause deadly diseases.
How was milk cooled before electricity?
screens.why: Cold underground water was pumped into a container.

screens.text: Bekele sells milk in town, 2 hours away. He has no refrigerator. What is the best idea from the lesson?
opts: Keep the milk in a container cooled by cold water
Open the container to air it
screens.ans: Keep the milk in a container cooled by cold water
screens.why: Cooling is the main preservation method. Cold water cooling worked before refrigerators.
screens.clue: What did people use before electricity?

test.text: A refrigerator is used to cool milk.
Cold-water cooling became popular after refrigerators.
